title: key tray
author: LayerCraft.
description:
Keep your essentials organized with this sleek and functional key tray. Perfect for holding keys, coins, wallets, or everyday carry items, this catchall tray is designed for entryways, desks, or nightstands. Its minimalist design blends into any environment while keeping clutter away.

Designed for easy 3D printing – no supports required. Optimized for FDM printers and tested in PLA, but works well with PETG too.

Great as a functional print or a thoughtful gift!
